title: The 10-minute payment check reads every old payment link of every gym, and old links are never removed
what: Every 10 minutes the server looks for payment links to check. Its search can only narrow by the link's state, so it reads every open, cancelled and expired link ever made, for all gyms, then sorts them, to pick 40. A second step reads every link of a payment company for each disconnected gym. Payment links are never deleted, so this work and the database bill grow with every link, 144 times a day.
expected: The check reads only the links still inside the checking window, using a lookup made for that, and links past the window are tidied away or kept out of the search.
who: MettleUp (server cost and speed once online payments are on)
how_often: every 10 minutes, growing with every payment link
fix_line: Add a lookup on the link's date and state for the 10-minute check, and remove or archive links long past their window

title: Each feedback or help message reads the whole feedback table to check the daily limit
what: Before saving a feedback or help question, the server counts the last day's messages. The count has no lookup by time that it can use, so it reads every stored message and crash report (kept up to a year) each time someone writes in.
expected: The daily-limit count reads only the last day's messages through a lookup on the time.
who: MettleUp (server cost); members and owners wait a little longer as messages pile up
fix_line: Add a lookup on the message time and use it for the daily-limit count
